definition: The task of generating a video sequence based on a natural language text description.
details: Text-to-video generation extends text-to-image techniques into the temporal dimension, requiring models to maintain visual consistency and plausible motion across generated frames in addition to matching the described content.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. And that is Text-to-Video Generation — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
